description: Use this when someone asks how to do an exercise, which muscles it works, or what to do instead. Shows it on the body map with its equipment, its cues and swaps that train the same thing. No account needed. Do not use to diagnose pain or to give rehab exercises.

exercise.description: The exercise's name ("Romanian deadlift") or Almost Fire key ("rdl").
